title: Replacement Benefit Table for the Crestline Road Hazard Plans
content:
When a tire covered by Road Hazard Protection cannot be repaired, it is replaced with the same tire at a Crestline store and the plan pays a share of the replacement tire's price. The table sets, plan by plan, the full-replacement period, how the share is prorated after it, how many replacements each wheel position may have, and which installation items come with a covered replacement.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full-replacement period, months from the start of coverage | 3 | 6 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 6 |
| Tread worn up to which the replacement is paid in full | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 3/32 inch | 2/32 inch |
| Basis of the prorated share | remaining usable tread | remaining usable tread | remaining usable tread | remaining usable tread | remaining usable tread | remaining usable tread |
| Rounding of the prorated share | down to a whole percent | down to a whole percent | down to a whole percent | down to a whole percent | down to a whole percent | down to a whole percent |
| Price the share is applied to | current selling price | current selling price | current selling price | current selling price | current selling price | current selling price |
| Covered replacements per wheel position over the term | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Mounting and balancing of the replacement free | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Valve stem (or TPMS kit) and disposal fee free | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| TPMS sensor destroyed by the same hazard replaced free | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Replacement tire stays covered for the rest of the term | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Matching full-size spare covered | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Damaged tire kept by Crestline | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

**Notes to the table.**
1. Full replacement ends when either limit is passed: the period in months, or the tread worn (the tire's original depth less its measured depth) going beyond the full-replacement wear figure.
2. After full replacement, the share is the remaining usable tread over the original usable tread, both measured down to the plan's coverage tread limit, rounded down to a whole percent.
3. The current selling price is the price of the same tire on the service date.
4. Where the plan does not make the replacement's tire stay covered, that wheel position is no longer covered after the replacement.

**Illustration (hypothetical tire).** On a hypothetical tire with 10/32 inch new tread and a 2/32 inch coverage limit, measured at 6/32 inch outside the full-replacement period, the usable tread is 4 of 8, so the share is 50 percent; at a hypothetical current selling price of 150.00 the plan pays 75.00.
